visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two Asian men stand on a wet wooden deck outside a building with large glass windows. One man on the left, wearing a green t-shirt, olive shorts, and a black tactical vest with sunglasses, approaches the other man on the right who wears a beige long-sleeve shirt and olive shorts. The man on the left points his finger and gestures excitedly while the other man adjusts his clear sunglasses. (2) The man in the green shirt continues pointing and talking animatedly, leaning forward. The man in the beige shirt stands with his hands on his hips, smiling awkwardly. The background features a tall tree trunk and lush green foliage. The lighting is overcast but bright. (3) The man on the left puts his hand to his forehead as if thinking, then points again. The man on the right crosses his arms, maintaining a patient but slightly confused expression. They are standing close to each other on the deck near outdoor furniture. (4) Both men are now engaged in a more interactive dialogue. The man on the left uses his hands to describe something large, then points at the other man. The man on the right laughs and gestures back, adjusting his stance. (5) They both look toward the camera in a POV setup. The man on the right attempts to demonstrate a complex hand gesture involving interlocking fingers to form a shape. The man on the left tries to mimic it, looking down at his hands with a focused, somewhat frustrated facial expression. (6) The man on the left gives up, looking frustrated. He waves his hands dismissively, shakes his head, and walks out of the frame to the right. The man in the beige shirt remains by the tree, looking directly at the camera with an annoyed expression as he speaks a final line.
